Task 2.0 CO Capture Island Design 2 Subtask 2.1 Preliminary Design Dastur International Inc. prepared the design basis, process model, and process design package, including the process flow diagram, utility flow diagram, heat and mass balance, preliminary plot plan, equipment list, preliminary electrical load list, and indicative instrument list for the CO capture unit. 2 Pre-FEED Study 4 DE-FE0031937 / 0001 Subtask 2.2 Detailed Design Dastur prepared the process and instrumentation diagram, control strategy, description, single line diagram for electrical, detailed equipment list, and final layout drawing for the CC unit. Task 3.0 Balance of Plant (Integration with CC Island) Design Subtask 3.1 Preliminary Design Dastur-led project team prepared the design basis and estimated the requirements of raw materials, electric power, water, fuel, and other utilities, and also prepared the process model and process design package, including the process flow diagram, utility flow diagram, heat and mass balance, preliminary plot plan, equipment list, preliminary electrical load list, indicative instrument list for BF gas tapping from main head, water gas shift, CO compression, process steam generator, and other auxiliary facilities. 2 Subtask 3.2 Detailed Design Dastur prepared the detailed design as mentioned below: a) Estimation of civil and structural buildings dimension and prepare design drawings b) System design, layout drawings, and operational philosophy for the water gas shift (WGS) island, water, effluent, steam, and lubrication systems. c) Basic piping layout drawing and preliminary bill of quantities for cost estimation. d) Power distribution system, single line diagram, the basic layout of cable gallery/trays, and preliminary BOQ for cost estimation. e) Control strategy, process, and instrumentation diagram for all sections. f) Detailed equipment list, final layout drawing for BFG tapping from main head, water gas shift, CO compression, CHP & other auxiliary facilities. 2 Task 4.0 Studies & Investigation Subtask 4.1 Steam and Electricity Sourcing Study Dastur International Inc. has conducted a steam and electricity sourcing study that describes the source, specification, and quantity of steam and electricity. Dastur reviewed alternative sources for required steam and electricity to optimize costs and ensure consistency of availability without compromising the existing operations. This study outcome has been described in Attachment 1. Subtask 4.2 Solvent Disposal Investigation Dastur reviewed the solvent characteristics from the operational philosophy & safety data sheet to decide on the treatment requirements of the degraded solvent, and the waste generated will be characterized adequately for appropriate disposal. Attachment 2 describes this in detail. Subtask 4.3 Wastewater Treatment Study Dastur estimated the quality & quantity of the wastewater generated from the water gas shift island and CO capture island and considered the same to be discharged in the existing project boundary for further 2 effluent treatment before sending it outside the site. This study outcome has been described in Attachment 3.
